initialization: pilot-1 original M1 final; never pilot-2 L1
loss: mean4 L full-target token NLL inclEOS + alpha*mean4 A full-target NLL inclEOS; alpha0/1, never divide combined objective by2

prompts.A: Does this chest radiograph contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.
prompts.L: Locate any lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia in this chest radiograph. Return only a JSON list of bounding boxes [[x1,y1,x2,y2],...], with coordinates normalized to 0–1000. Return [] when no target finding is visible.
prompts.C: Does the visible region contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.

generation: historical greedy, no forced nonempty, no beam search or cap extension
token_span_policy: verified tokenizer offsets, mutually exclusive divergence/digits/structure/mixed/EOS; divergence overrides character category; offsets must reproduce exact ASCII target; unknown if unavailable
budget_policy: sum of GPU worker wall time; loading, diagnostics, gradients, training, evaluation and failures included; no automatic retry

numeric_tolerance.reason: two bf16 epsilon; historical actual repeated-backward discrepancy .006211, fixed before native pilot3 check

train_image_inputs: unannotated original image only; no labels, GT boxes, overlays or AI review in question
selection: all original71 single-box train positives; retain old Fit16 negatives; stable-sort remaining train negatives then seed17 choose240
schedule: one pre-generated seed17 class-wise permutation; cycle without replacement; alternating positive/negative four slots; 512/512 exposures
